CHIEF COMPLAINT
Annual exam

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Andrea is a 52-year-old female with a past medical history significant for rheumatoid arthritis, atrial fibrillation, and reflux presenting for her annual exam. She reports good compliance with exercise, walking, and yoga over the past year, which has helped significantly with her arthritis. She denies any joint pain, stiffness, or flare-ups over the last year. Regarding her atrial fibrillation, she continues to experience palpitations, with the most recent episode occurring about a week ago. She has noticed that stress triggers her palpitations and has been attempting stress management through meditation and running with her dog, without significant improvement. An event monitor was performed last month. For her reflux, she reports good control on protonix and has made dietary modifications including cutting out soda. She has not had a reflux flare-up in over five months.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient endorsed palpitations and nasal congestion related to allergies. Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, nausea, or vomiting.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Rheumatoid arthritis
Atrial fibrillation
Reflux

MEDICATIONS
Methotrexate 2.5 mg once weekly
Protonix 40 mg daily

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient exercises regularly, including walking and yoga. She runs with her dog for stress relief.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital signs: Heart rate well-controlled and regular. Heart: Slight 2/6 systolic ejection murmur appreciated, consistent with prior exams; regular rate and rhythm at this time. Lungs: Clear bilaterally. Right elbow: Edema and erythema noted with pain to palpation. Lower extremities: No edema.

RESULTS
Event monitor: Shows atrial fibrillation with conversion pauses, patient going in and out of normal rhythm.
Autoimmune panel: All values well-controlled on current methotrexate therapy for rheumatoid arthritis.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Rheumatoid arthritis: Continue methotrexate 2.5 mg once weekly. Prescription refilled. Refer to rheumatologist as needed; currently stable.
2. Atrial fibrillation: Refer to cardiology for cardiac ablation to map and ablate the source of arrhythmia to maintain normal sinus rhythm.
3. Reflux: Continue protonix 40 mg daily. Continue dietary modifications including avoidance of coffee and spicy foods. Follow up as needed.
